newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - HK Newspaper Editorials - July 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - HK Newspaper Editorials - July 4.

text.p: These are highlights of comments in the Hong Kong press. The views expressed are those of the newspapers quoted and do not represent an editorial viewpoint of Reuters.

-- ECONOMIC JOURNAL said that after the Hong Kong handover, Beijing's next target would be Taiwan, but Taipei had clearly rejected the "one country, two systems" mode. The paper said Beijing had to come up with a new set of concepts and methods to resolve the Taiwan issue. It said as democracy in Taiwan further developed, a party advocating Taiwan independence would come to power one day. The Hong Kong government should provide necesary support for final reunification of China and Taiwan, it said.

-- The Beijing-backed WEN WEI PO commented on Hong Kong's return to China, saying the "one country, two systems" policy would have a much wider and deeper impact on the world. It said the concept had set a successful example of how to solve complicated international arguments.

-- The English-language HONGKONG STANDARD said that by strengthening ties between Hong Kong and Taiwan and allowing Taiwan officials to come here, Taipei could have as close a look as it wanted of developments here and, much more importantly, the workings of "one country, two systems". So it was important that the concept be made to work and be safeguarded, the paper said.
